mtls_mode.title: mTLS Mode
mtls_mode.description: The mutual TLS mode configured for service-to-service communication, indicating whether client certificates are required, optional, or not enforced.

client_certificate_required.title: Client Certificate Required
client_certificate_required.description: Whether the service explicitly requires a valid client certificate before accepting inbound connections from other services.

plaintext_fallback_allowed.title: Plaintext Fallback Allowed
plaintext_fallback_allowed.description: Whether the service permits connections that fall back to plaintext or unauthenticated TLS when the peer does not present a client certificate.

certificate_validation_mode.title: Certificate Validation Mode
certificate_validation_mode.description: How the service validates TLS certificates from peer services during mTLS or TLS connections. Consolidates hostname verification and CA bundle checks into a single enum.

trusted_ca_bundle_configured.title: Trusted CA Bundle Configured
trusted_ca_bundle_configured.description: Whether a specific trusted CA bundle or certificate pinning is configured for validating peer service certificates, rather than relying on system defaults or skipping validation.

self_signed_certs_accepted_without_pinni.title: Self-Signed Certificates Accepted Without Pinning
self_signed_certs_accepted_without_pinni.description: Whether the service accepts self-signed certificates from peer services without certificate pinning, allowing any self-signed cert to be trusted.

minimum_tls_version.title: Minimum TLS Version
minimum_tls_version.description: The minimum TLS protocol version accepted by the service for inbound and outbound connections.

weak_cipher_suites_enabled.title: Weak Cipher Suites Enabled
weak_cipher_suites_enabled.description: Whether the service permits cipher suites known to be cryptographically weak (e.g., RC4, DES, 3DES, NULL, EXPORT-grade, or anonymous DH ciphers).

tls_version_downgrade_protection_enabled.title: TLS Downgrade Protection Enabled
tls_version_downgrade_protection_enabled.description: Whether the service enforces TLS_FALLBACK_SCSV or equivalent mechanism to prevent protocol downgrade attacks.

payload_signing_mechanism.title: Payload Signing Mechanism
payload_signing_mechanism.description: The application-layer mechanism used to sign or authenticate message payloads independent of TLS, such as HMAC or digital signatures.

tls_termination_at_intermediary.title: TLS Terminated at Intermediary
tls_termination_at_intermediary.description: Whether TLS is terminated at an intermediary component (e.g., sidecar proxy, ingress controller, or load balancer) before reaching the destination service, creating a plaintext segment.

service_mesh_integrity_policy_enforced.title: Service Mesh Integrity Policy Enforced
service_mesh_integrity_policy_enforced.description: Whether the service mesh enforces a policy requiring application-layer payload integrity verification (e.g., via Istio AuthorizationPolicy with custom headers, OPA sidecar checks, or equivalent).

request_replay_protection_mechanism.title: Request Replay Protection Mechanism
request_replay_protection_mechanism.description: Indicates whether service-to-service API requests include replay protection controls such as nonces, timestamps, or sequence numbers in the message payload or headers.

replay_window_enforcement_enabled.title: Replay Window Enforcement Enabled
replay_window_enforcement_enabled.description: Whether the receiving service validates that incoming requests fall within an acceptable time window or have not been seen before (e.g., timestamp skew check, nonce deduplication store).

service_discovery_tls_enabled.title: Service Discovery TLS Enabled
service_discovery_tls_enabled.description: Whether TLS is configured and enforced for service registry communication (e.g., Consul HTTP/gRPC API, etcd client connections, DNS-SD).

service_discovery_auth_enabled.title: Service Discovery Authentication Enabled
service_discovery_auth_enabled.description: Whether authentication (e.g., mTLS client certificates, ACL tokens, API keys) is required for service registry queries and registrations.

service_registry_network_exposure.title: Service Registry Network Exposure
service_registry_network_exposure.description: The network scope on which the service registry API is reachable, indicating blast radius if communication is unencrypted or unauthenticated.

rate_limiting_policy_enforced.title: Rate Limiting Policy Enforced
rate_limiting_policy_enforced.description: Indicates whether rate limiting or traffic shaping policies are applied at the inter-service communication layer to control request throughput between microservices.

circuit_breaker_configured.title: Circuit Breaker Configured
circuit_breaker_configured.description: Indicates whether circuit breaker patterns are configured for downstream service calls, providing a secondary mechanism to prevent cascading failures when rate limiting is absent.

inter_service_traffic_control_mechanism.title: Inter-Service Traffic Control Mechanism
inter_service_traffic_control_mechanism.description: The mechanism in place (if any) for managing inter-service traffic volume and shaping.

certificate_max_validity_days.title: Certificate Maximum Validity Period (Days)
certificate_max_validity_days.description: The maximum number of days service certificates are valid before expiry. Long-lived certificates extend the window of exposure if a private key is compromised.

automatic_rotation_enabled.title: Automatic Certificate Rotation Enabled
automatic_rotation_enabled.description: Indicates whether the service certificate is automatically rotated before expiry by a controller or agent (e.g., cert-manager, Istio Citadel, SPIFFE/SPIRE). When false, rotation relies on manual processes which are frequently skipped or delayed.

crl_or_ocsp_enforced.title: Certificate Revocation (CRL/OCSP) Enforced
crl_or_ocsp_enforced.description: Indicates whether certificate revocation via CRL or OCSP is actively checked and enforced during mTLS handshakes. Without revocation enforcement, a compromised certificate remains usable until natural expiry.

network_policy_enforced.title: Network Policy Enforced
network_policy_enforced.description: Whether Kubernetes NetworkPolicy or equivalent network-level policies are applied to restrict inter-service communication, rather than allowing all pods to communicate freely.

service_mesh_authorization_policy_enforc.title: Service Mesh Authorization Policy Enforced
service_mesh_authorization_policy_enforc.description: Whether a service mesh is deployed with AuthorizationPolicy or equivalent rules that explicitly restrict which source services may call which destination services.

default_deny_posture.title: Default Deny Posture Active
default_deny_posture.description: Whether a default-deny rule exists at the network or mesh layer such that any inter-service communication not explicitly permitted is blocked by default.

tls_reencryption_to_backend_enabled.title: TLS Re-encryption to Backend Enabled
tls_reencryption_to_backend_enabled.description: Whether the proxy or ingress re-encrypts traffic after TLS termination before forwarding to the destination service, ensuring no plaintext segment exists in transit.

proxy_trust_boundary_scope.title: Proxy Trust Boundary Scope
proxy_trust_boundary_scope.description: Whether the terminating proxy is shared across multiple trust boundaries (e.g., serving services from different security zones or tenants) or is dedicated to a single trust boundary.

backend_protocol.title: Backend Communication Protocol
backend_protocol.description: The protocol used by the proxy to communicate with the backend destination service after TLS termination.
